events.name: Fort White Town Council — Special Meeting on Dissolution
events.description: Special meeting on potential town dissolution. Four council members voted in January to hold this meeting so residents can voice their opinions on whether Fort White should dissolve into Columbia County. Public comment period available.

events.name: Fort White Indians Baseball vs Lafayette (District Game)
events.description: Fort White Indians (0-3) host the Lafayette Hornets in a district matchup. The Indians are looking for their first win of the season after losses to Taylor County (1-9), Chiefland (2-8), and SFCA (5-7).

events.name: Visit Florida CEO Bryan Griffin at Lake City Chamber Coffee & Commerce
events.description: Visit Florida President and CEO Bryan Griffin will speak at the Lake City-Columbia County Chamber's Coffee & Commerce program, sharing insights on tourism and economic development. Per WCJB's Week Ahead report.
